mcp_tools_source: upstream skills/open-websearch/SKILL.md allowed-tools at audited HEAD; runtime tools/list in tools-list.json when G3 passes
risk_notes: Scraping-based search engines; rate limits and ToS apply
Optional Playwright for Bing; wrapper defaults SEARCH_MODE=request
Broad network egress; treat fetched content as untrusted
FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS and proxy settings are user-owned only
dedupe_summary: Complements brave-search, duckduckgo-search, ddgs, tavily, exa, g-search with no-API-key multi-engine search plus article/README fetch; not a harness default replacement
